text:
Alex W: Heads-up — Steadfast Edge is ready for Dedicated cutover tomorrow during the 02:00-04:00 UTC window. Can we get ops signoff?
Tess: +1 from PM side. Release notes posted: https://redwood.company/releases/steadfast-edge-1.4.0 — highlights: cold-start latency improvements, kvcache fixes.
deploybot: Deploy plan created: https://deploybot/redwood/1719876543 — canary 5% for 15m, then 25% for 10m, then 100% if healthy.
Ricardo: Quick checklist: KMS rotation not happening, DB migrations are noop, policy pin at model v1.4.0-rc3. Lina can confirm KMS.
Lina: Confirmed — KMS window clear. I checked key ACLs and rotation schedule, no collisions. :thumbsup:
Maya (oncall): I'm on-call for the window. Will watch latency SLOs and error-rate. Pager rules ready.
Alex W: Rollback thresholds we agreed: if 95th latency > 250ms above baseline for 3 consecutive minutes or 5xx rate > 0.5% over 10m -> immediate rollback to v1.4.0-rc1.
Tess: Adding QA note — eval suite passed on sample tenant traffic. No regression on tokenization.
Ricardo: Need an explicit pin in the deployment manifest. Alex, can you add the manifest snippet?
Alex W: Pushed manifest diff to the deploy PR. Snippet:
```yaml
deployment:
  model_version: "v1.4.0-rc3"
  canary_policy:
    - percent: 5
      duration: 15m
    - percent: 25
      duration: 10m
```
Lina: Also toggling KV cache prime for the first 5 minutes to avoid cold misses. Added to runbook.
Maya (oncall): I'll create an alert dashboard and link it in the runbook.
deploybot: @Alex W requested: runbook attachment missing a postmortem-owner field. Please add before lock.
Alex W: Added postmortem-owner: "Alex W" and oncall-runbook link.
Tess: Who is signing off from infra? @Ricardo?
Ricardo: I approve the window. +1 for go.
Lina: +1 from security/KMS.
Maya (oncall): +1 oncall. Monitoring dashboards look good.
Alex W: Great — final go/no-go: all approvals collected. I'll lock the change window and start the deploy at 02:05 UTC.
Tess: Thanks folks. Please annotate any anomalies in the thread during the window.
Ricardo: Noted. If we hit rollback, tag #incidents and ping infra oncall.
deploybot: Schedule locked. Will post status messages into this thread during rollout. :rocket:
